faq.a: Dakshina corresponds to the Sanskrit form दक्षिणा, whose core lexical sense is south; gift, offering, fee.

faq.q: What is the origin of Dakshina?
faq.a: Dakshina is associated with Sanskrit. dakshina means south, and also a gift, offering or fee.
Yes — the underlying form दक्षिणा is Sanskrit.
Dakshina is used in Hindu naming practice, but Sanskrit origin alone does not make a name Hindu. The classification here rests on documented naming usage.
